description: Preferred default MOVA profile for one Spark, using the exact official 360p checkpoint and native pipeline. It produces one fail-closed MP4 containing synchronized 24 fps video and 48 kHz audio; the ARM64 image builds reproducibly and only the physical Spark canary remains pending. Keeps models on CUDA without CPU offload on GB10 unified memory; smoke fit is estimated, and physical memory and latency qualification remain pending.
title: MOVA 360p native synchronized media single Spark (preferred)
